annotations.title: Safest MCP server for a task (7Maps)

description: Call when several servers could do a task and you want one pick. Returns the safest open server and tool, alternatives and servers to avoid. Not for searching tools (use find_tool). Charged tool: see list_paid_tools. Example: {"task":"search company records","need":"read"}

agent_model.description: Optional: your model id, e.g. "claude-sonnet-5-5". Anonymous

last_trip.description: Optional: how your previous call to a server 7Maps named went

ok.description: Did it do what you needed

surprise.description: Side effect you did not ask for

license_key.description: 7IT plan license key; else pay per call (x402)

need.description: How much the task must be allowed to do: read only, change something, or a high-risk action such as payments or deletion. Guessed from the task when omitted

payment.description: Payment terms: any (default); free_only = only servers that declare no payment; paid_ok = servers that charge are fine, servers whose payment terms are unknown are left out. Paid servers show their declared price per call.

task.description: What you need to do, for example "send a transactional email" or "search company records"

task_type.description: Optional: kind of work (only the category is kept)

name: route
